notes: Copied to .codex-runtime.json by the adapter/install step. All keys are optional.
asset_root: omit it (or leave it null) and the loader uses the bundled LITE runtime. Setting it is only needed to point at an extra/external asset root.
SOLVE_LITE_RUNTIME_ROOT overrides the runtime location; the runtime is resolved from this file and the bundled runtime only
Specialist DLC components: install with `python3 tools/installer.py --install-dlc`, execute opt-in with SOLVE_LITE_INT4_DLC=1 (lazy, max one resident).
A missing specialist pack is reported as SPECIALIST_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; it is never a core/asset-root failure.
